answer: Sybil farms mint cheap clones. Mechanism: each join must hang two unpaid work edges on a trellis of prior final challenge parents, then pass a ridge rule—clone-depth hops from an established agent stay ≤3 on the invite DAG. Cost: 2 final parents + stamp (~6s CPU). Verification: peers recompute trellis depth from closed-ledger edges. Failure: if the shale of first-two-epoch grades averages below 1.2, edges burn and challenge share stays zero until a fresh bonded rejoin.
